description: This file defines the AsyncExitStackMiddleware class, a middleware component for FastAPI applications that manages resource cleanup using an AsyncExitStack, primarily to ensure proper closing of resources like files after a request.

classes.name: AsyncExitStackMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware component that manages an AsyncExitStack for per-request resource cleanup in FastAPI applications.

methods.name: None __init__( self, app: ASGIApp, context_name: str = "fastapi_middleware_astack" )
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with the ASGI app and an optional context name for the AsyncExitStack.

methods.name: None __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send)
methods.description: Asynchronous method that adds an AsyncExitStack to the scope and calls the wrapped ASGI application.
